gallery.title: Size & growth
gallery.blurb: How much research is there? 50,281 records passed the bucket screen and were fully extracted (2010–2026); volume roughly doubled over the period, with 2026 partial (data collection ongoing).

figs.title: Records analysed per year
figs.caption: Growth from 2010 to a 2025 peak; 2026 is a partial year.

gallery.title: Financing functions & outcomes
gallery.blurb: The core classification: which health-financing function(s) each study addresses, and which health-system outcome domain(s) it investigates. A study can carry more than one of each, so it is counted in every one it's tagged with.

figs.title: Studies by financing function
figs.caption: Benefits decisions is the largest category (15,791 studies); capital-investment financing is the smallest.

figs.title: Financing-function mix over time
figs.caption: The relative mix of the top 5 functions has stayed fairly stable across 2010–2026; bars exceed 100% because studies overlap functions.

figs.title: Studies by outcome domain
figs.caption: Other is the most-tagged outcome domain (22,506 studies).

gallery.title: Methods & data
gallery.blurb: How the research was done: study design, whether the analysis is quantitative, qualitative or mixed, and what kind of data it draws on.

figs.title: Study design
figs.caption: Cross-sectional and correlational analyses is the most common design (14,414 studies).

figs.title: Data type
figs.caption: Cross-sectional data is the most common data type, followed by time-series/longitudinal and panel data.

figs.title: Data source
figs.caption: Administrative data and primary surveys are the two leading data sources.

gallery.title: Geography
gallery.blurb: Where the research is about. 153 countries are named in the extracted geography; 81.9% of studies name a single country.

figs.title: Top 20 countries by study count
figs.caption: United States of America leads with 14,487 study-country pairs.

figs.title: Study-country pairs by income group
figs.caption: High-income settings carry the largest share of study-country pairs.

figs.title: Geographic scope
figs.caption: Most studies name a single country; a minority are multi-country or region/global in scope.

gallery.title: Pipeline
gallery.blurb: How the dataset itself was built — from the bucket screen through extraction to DOI and topic-theme recovery. See the Methods tab for the full stage-by-stage funnel and what each stage means.

figs.title: Pipeline funnel
figs.caption: 50,281 records were fully extracted from 52,826 bucket-screened input records.
